property_summary: For every non-owner caller and any positive amount sent from C via sendMoney to a callee that reverts on receiving funds, the reference contract will not lose balance because onlyOwner prevents the non-owner from calling sendMoney, while the mutant (onlyOwner always true) allows the non-owner to invoke sendMoney and thus can change address(c).balance for some inputs.
change_summary: Relax onlyOwner to allow anyone to call functions guarded by it by changing require to always pass (no ownership check).
